reviews.title: Incorrect Answers & Can’t Report Issues
reviews.text:
This app is not worth the time it takes to download. The first thing you see upon opening the app is a request to buy a yearly subscription, which you opt out of by choosing to watch ads. That’s fine, but every time you try to do anything this same box pops up, defaulted to a yearly subscription, and you have to manually select to watch ads again.
When you finally finish the tests, you are shown your scores, which are not explained well at all. You can go and review the questions you missed, which is nice, but the answers in the system are not always correct! At least two of the questions that I got wrong, upon reviewing the correct answer and reading their “hint” explaining the correct answer, they were explaining what I had chosen. On one, there were two numbers in different colors, they explained the answer as I put as being correct, but they had input the opposite option as the correct answer. On the second question they explained my answer as being correct, but had it marked as wrong and had no answer listed as the correct choice, so you would have gotten it wrong no matter what you chose.
As this is a “free” app, you can’t report an issue. I tried to report an issue with the incorrect answers, but since it shows as a free app and not a purchased app, it won’t let you submit a report.
If you want to just play the same memory quizzes over and over and take the same test multiple times, while watching ads every time you start a task, then go right ahead, but I’ve definitely used much better apps than this for memory training.
